name: cat-intelligence-agency
description: Cat Intelligence Agency: pixel-kitten agents that investigate the crypto market on X, the $CIA memecoin site, and CoinMarketCat, the agentic trading cat: a Chrome extension that trades Solana spot tokens from a strategy you write in plain English. On a schedule you choose it asks a model, with your own Anthropic API key, what to do about the tokens you list; deterministic code then applies your limits (per-token cap, exposure, stop loss, take profit, daily drawdown, trades per day, slippage), which the model cannot change. Paper by default; live from an autopilot wallet you fund and unlock. Spot only, no leverage, and it runs only while Chrome is open. Snipurr, the pump.fun sniper cat, is its other lane. CoinMarketCat is not affiliated with CoinMarketCap.
